text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Half-hourly output, 00:00 UTC on 15 June 2026 to 23:30 UTC on 21 June 2026, in megawatts. Blue: pure PV. Orange: solar BMU at a hybrid site. Purple: storage BMU at that site. Examples span the best to the worst fit to the sun; the page's methods give the rule.'
text.tspan: Half-hourly output, 00:00 UTC on 15 June 2026 to 23:30 UTC on 21 June 2026, in megawatts.
Blue: pure PV. Orange: solar BMU at a hybrid site. Purple: storage BMU at that site.
Examples span the best to the worst fit to the sun; the page's methods give the rule.
